testsuite.name: org.mozilla.fenix.utils.SettingsTest

testcase.name: GIVEN startOnHomeAfterFourHours is selected after four hours of inactivity WHEN calling shouldStartOnHome THEN return true
WHEN old cleanup file preference is DELETE_FROM_DEVICE THEN delete behavior should be ASK_WHEN_DELETING
GIVEN top composable toolbar is enabled WHEN querying the toolbar height THEN get the height of the composable toolbar
WHEN user has accepted the ToU THEN termsOfUseAcceptedVersion returns the ToU version
GIVEN the time since last prompt is too short WHEN checking prompt eligibility THEN shouldShowSetAsDefaultPrompt is false
GIVEN Https-only mode is enabled for all tabs THEN the engine mode is HttpsOnlyMode#ENABLED
GIVEN open links in apps setting THEN return the correct display string
GIVEN bottom composable toolbar is enabled and navigation bar is enabled but window is not tall enough WHEN querying the toolbar height THEN get the height of the composable toolbar
GIVEN the feature flag default WHEN the user has not been onboarded THEN shouldShowOnboarding is false
GIVEN feature is enabled, hasUserBeenOnboarded is false THEN shouldShowOnboarding returns false
GIVEN startOnHomeAlways is selected WHEN calling shouldStartOnHome THEN return true
GIVEN not enough cold starts WHEN checking prompt eligibility THEN shouldShowSetAsDefaultPrompt is false
GIVEN previously stored pref_key_search_widget_installed value is Boolean WHEN calling migrateSearchWidgetInstalledIfNeeded THEN crash should not happen
GIVEN unset user preferences THEN https-only is disabled
GIVEN shouldShowInactiveTabsAutoCloseDialog WHEN the dialog has been dismissed before THEN no show the dialog
GIVEN feature is enabled, hasUserBeenOnboarded is true THEN shouldShowOnboarding returns false
GIVEN the conditions to show a prompt are not met WHEN checking prompt eligibility THEN shouldShowSetAsDefaultPrompt is false
GIVEN previously stored pref_key_last_review_prompt_shown_time value is a String WHEN calling migrateLastReviewPromptTimePrefIfNeeded THEN crash should not happen
WHEN no preference is stored THEN delete download behavior should be ASK_WHEN_DELETING
GIVEN other conditions are valid WHEN the default browser prompt is disabled THEN shouldShowSetAsDefaultPrompt is false
GIVEN none previously stored pref_key_last_review_prompt_shown_time value WHEN calling migrateLastReviewPromptTimePrefIfNeeded THEN migration should not happen
WHEN old download delete behavior preference is DELETE_FROM_DEVICE THEN delete behavior should be ASK_WHEN_DELETING
GIVEN the prompt has been shown maximum times WHEN checking prompt eligibility THEN shouldShowSetAsDefaultPrompt is false
GIVEN other conditions are valid WHEN the days between prompts is null THEN the value is ignored
WHEN user has accepted the ToU THEN termsOfUseAcceptedTimeInMillis returns the app installed time
WHEN user has not accepted the ToU THEN termsOfUseAcceptedVersion returns 0
GIVEN startOnHomeAfterFourHours is selected and with recent activity WHEN calling shouldStartOnHome THEN return false
GIVEN unset user preferences THEN https-only is disabled for private tabs
GIVEN other conditions are valid WHEN max prompts shown is null THEN the value is ignored
GIVEN shouldShowInactiveTabsAutoCloseDialog WHEN the inactive tabs are less than the minimum THEN no show the dialog
GIVEN enough cold starts and conditions met WHEN checking prompt eligibility THEN shouldShowSetAsDefaultPrompt is true
GIVEN a written integer value for pref_key_search_widget_installed WHEN reading searchWidgetInstalled THEN do not throw a ClassCastException
GIVEN feature is disabled, hasUserBeenOnboarded is true THEN shouldShowOnboarding returns false
GIVEN shouldShowInactiveTabsAutoCloseDialog WHEN closeTabsAfterOneMonth is already selected THEN no show the dialog
GIVEN Https-only mode is disabled THEN the engine mode is HttpsOnlyMode#DISABLED
GIVEN previously stored pref_key_search_widget_installed value WHEN calling migrateSearchWidgetInstalledIfNeeded THEN migrate the value
GIVEN Https-only mode is enabled THEN the engine mode is HttpsOnlyMode#ENABLED
GIVEN Https-only mode is enabled for only private tabs THEN the engine mode is HttpsOnlyMode#ENABLED_PRIVATE_ONLY
GIVEN unset user preferences THEN https-only is enabled for all tabs
GIVEN startOnHomeNever is selected WHEN calling shouldStartOnHome THEN return be false
GIVEN shouldShowInactiveTabsAutoCloseDialog WHEN the dialog has not been dismissed, with more inactive tabs than the queried and closeTabsAfterOneMonth not set THEN show the dialog
GIVEN none previously stored pref_key_search_widget_installed value WHEN calling migrateSearchWidgetInstalledIfNeeded THEN migration should not happen
GIVEN enablePersistentOnboarding is true THEN shouldShowOnboarding still returns false
GIVEN previously stored pref_key_last_review_prompt_shown_time value WHEN calling migrateLastReviewPromptTimePrefIfNeeded THEN migrate the value
GIVEN bottom composable toolbar is enabled and navigation bar is disabled WHEN querying the toolbar height THEN get the height of the composable toolbar
WHEN download deletion behavior preference is read THEN it should read from the new preference
WHEN user has not accepted the ToU THEN termsOfUseAcceptedTimeInMillis returns 0L
GIVEN other conditions are valid WHEN cold starts between prompts is null THEN the value is ignored
GIVEN bottom composable toolbar is enabled and navigation bar is enabled but window is too wide WHEN querying the toolbar height THEN get the height of the composable toolbar
WHEN old download delete behavior preference is REMOVE_FROM_HISTORY THEN delete behavior should be ASK_WHEN_DELETING
GIVEN bottom composable toolbar is enabled and navigation bar is enabled WHEN querying the toolbar height THEN get the height of the composable toolbar
